name: Cusco
blurb: Cusco remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Easy to get around without a car
Good value compared with last year
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Not the easiest place to reach, which is probably why it is still calm.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
